real_apply_gates: git pull --ff-only origin main must pass
git status --short must be clean or only expected apply outputs after run
real SQLite DB must exist at /root/tokenoskobi_clean_v1/data/tokenoskobi_clean_v1.sqlite
full SQLite DB backup must be created before schema/write
news_token_match_events table must be created if missing
news_signal_events table must be created if missing
news_score_events_v1 table must be created if missing
news_runtime_freshness_v1 table must be created if missing
raw news count must remain unchanged except approved downstream tables
writes must be limited to news downstream tables and panel readmodel JSON files
no systemd start/stop/restart in this apply
no API/provider/wallet/trade action in this apply
panel HTTPS JSON must return HTTP 200 after apply
backup path must be recorded in result JSON
blocked_actions: schema changes outside news downstream tables
rollback_rule: If post-audit fails, restore the SQLite file from the pre-apply backup and revert panel JSON files via git checkout before any further work.
